statement: At pinned dekuNukem revision b354f21, community Nintendo Switch controller-family reverse-engineering notes document an NFC/IR MCU report path using output report 0x11, input report 0x31, and MCU-related subcommands 0x20, 0x21, and 0x22. These family-level notes do not establish an observed Switch Pro NFC transaction, Pro-specific acceptance of the commands, a successful NFC tag read or write, or behavior over USB. This is source-only device-side protocol context, not a physically validated Switch Pro implementation.

applicability.revision: Nintendo Switch controller-family community notes at b354f21; specific retail Switch Pro revision not measured
applicability.scope: Family-level, Bluetooth-focused protocol descriptions only: pinned bluetooth_hid_notes.md lines 35-39, 120-124, 150-155; pinned bluetooth_hid_subcommands_notes.md lines 68-83, 174-191. Does not transfer Joy-Con-specific NFC consumer sequences to a Pro Controller or establish wireless or wired host acceptance.
